title: OAuth2 Token Orchestrator
description: Consolidated OAuth2 token exchange and caching policy

cacheResource.title: Cache Resource
cacheResource.description: Name of the Gravitee Cache Resource to use.

tokenEndpoint.title: Token Endpoint
tokenEndpoint.description: The full URL to the OAuth2 provider token endpoint.

grantType.title: Grant Type
grantType.description: The OAuth2 grant_type (e.g., urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange). Required for requestFormat 'form'; ignored for 'json', where the body is built from parameters alone.

parameters.title: Additional Parameters
parameters.description: Extra request fields, values may be EL expressions. For requestFormat 'json' this map IS the request body.

clientAuthMethod.title: Client Authentication Method
clientAuthMethod.description: How client credentials are presented (RFC 6749 §2.3.1). 'client_secret_post' puts them in the request body; 'client_secret_basic' sends an Authorization: Basic header and omits them from the body.

requestFormat.title: Request Body Format
requestFormat.description: 'form' sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded with grant_type and client credentials. 'json' sends an application/json object built from parameters alone, for mint endpoints that are not OAuth2 token endpoints.

tokenPath.title: Token Field Path
tokenPath.description: Dot-separated path to the token in the response, e.g. 'access_token', 'accessToken', 'data.token'. A leading '$.' is accepted and ignored.

maxTtl.title: Maximum TTL (seconds)
maxTtl.description: Upper bound on the cache TTL. 0 means unbounded, leaving the TTL as derived from expires_in or the JWT exp claim. Set this when the provider issues a long-lived token but its underlying credential can be rotated, so a rotation takes effect within a bounded window.
